label: prop:genus-filtration-ideal
title: Genus-filtration ideal and the Chebyshev obstruction for $T_{2,p}$
html:
Proposition. Genus-filtration ideal and the Chebyshev obstruction for T_{2,p}

At g = 4 the embeddable torus knots T_{r,s}, r \in \{2, 3\}, first number at least the five irreducibles of H_2(q) \oplus H_3(q) (genus from Hecke completeness). That count is proved. It does not fix the genus: the six evaluations available at g = 4 do not span the five-dimensional representation, because a T_{r,s} evaluates only in the H_r(q) columns and the resulting block-diagonal matrix has rank at most 2 + 2 = 4 for every q (the block-rank remark). So g = 4 is taken as given below rather than derived from the algebra here. The genus-filtration ideal \mathfrak{I}_4 = (u^5) serves as the algebraic obstruction that kills T_{2,p} for all primes p \geq 11.
